description: React component for a map view control in a data exploration UI, including styling, state management, and interaction logic.

classes.name: MapViewControl
classes.description: React functional component implementing map view configuration controls.

methods.name: onTagClick
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the popover.

methods.name: isCustomMode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is 'CUSTOM'.

methods.name: onModeChange
methods.description: Handles change of map mode between 'FIT_DATA' and 'CUSTOM'.

methods.name: onButtonClick
methods.description: Sets map view to current extent when button is clicked.

methods.name: onSaveClick
methods.description: Saves the new map view configuration and closes the popover.
